transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: Severus, the Mark's magical signature is... changing. I can't tell whether it's reacting to something external or whether the curse itself is evolving. Your core magic appears stable, but I need to run deeper diagnostic charms that will take several days and may be uncomfortable. I cannot yet tell you whether this is dangerous.

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: Several days? (He glances at the calendar on the wall, then back to the Healer) I have prior commitments that I cannot neglect. I assume you are aware of the urgency of my position.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: I understand your commitments, Severus. Believe me, I wouldn't suggest such an extensive battery of tests if it weren't absolutely necessary. The nature of these particular magical shifts is unprecedented, and superficial scans simply won't give us the answers we need. We're dealing with very dark magic here, as you well know, and any change to its signature warrants thorough investigation. Your position is precisely *why* we cannot afford to be anything less than meticulous. We need to understand what this means, and quickly.

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: Very well. (He stands, bracing himself against the aftereffects of the diagnostic charm) When can we begin? And how long will it take to interpret the results? I assume you'll inform me immediately of any significant findings.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text:
We can begin immediately, Severus. There's no benefit in delay. The deeper diagnostic charms themselves will take the "several days" I mentioned, as some require specific magical conditions to be observed over time, and others are simply too intricate to run concurrently. Interpreting the results will then take additional time, as we'll need to cross-reference multiple magical readings, arcane texts, and consult with specialists in dark curses. This isn't a simple case of reading a single parchment.

I will, of course, keep you informed. You'll be the first to know of any significant or conclusive findings. However, understand that this process may involve many small, inconclusive observations before we can piece together a coherent picture. We're looking for patterns, not just single events. Are you prepared to remain here for the duration, or will we need to make arrangements for daily visits?

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: I can't remain here indefinitely. (He strides to the door, then turns) I'll return daily for updates. You'll send for me immediately if anything conclusive arises. I trust you'll maintain confidentiality. This... (He indicates the Mark) is not to be discussed with anyone else, understood?

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text:
Understood, Severus. Your confidentiality is absolutely assured; it's fundamental to our practice here at St. Mungo's, particularly with cases of this nature. This matter will remain strictly between us and the diagnostic teams directly involved, all of whom are bound by the strictest oaths.

Daily visits will be necessary, then. We'll arrange a schedule that minimises disruption to your other duties, as much as possible, while ensuring we can conduct the necessary observations. We'll need a consistent window each day. And yes, you have my word: if anything definitive or acutely concerning emerges, you will be sent for immediately, no matter the hour. We'll require you to be reachable.

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: I can set aside an hour each day, but no more. (He looks at the Healer, his eyes narrowed) I assume you'll ensure that each session is efficient and purposeful. I don't have the luxury of idly waiting for your... leisurely pace of deduction to yield results.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text:
An hour each day, Severus. Very well. We will absolutely ensure that every moment is purposeful and efficient. We understand the constraints of dark magic diagnostics are not always amenable to a simple, swift resolution, but we will make the most of the time you can spare.

We'll schedule your daily sessions at the most opportune time for the specific charms we need to run, aiming to gather as much data as possible within that hour. We'll send you a schedule for the first few days. Please ensure you are prompt.

Is there a particular time of day that would be most suitable for your hour-long session, given your other commitments?

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: The hours before breakfast are typically unencumbered by other obligations. (He offers a small, wry smile) It's a... convenient time to be poked and prodded, isn't it? I expect to be sent for around 6:30 AM, if that's agreeable to your team.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text:
6:30 AM. Excellent, Severus. That will indeed be agreeable to our diagnostic teams. We'll ensure everything is prepared and ready for your arrival promptly at that time each morning. It allows us to perform some of the more sensitive charms before the general hustle and bustle of the hospital, which can be advantageous.

We'll be expecting you then, beginning tomorrow. Please ensure you're well-rested, as some of the charms, while brief, can be quite draining. We'll do our utmost to make each session as efficient as possible within your allotted hour.

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: Rest, (He snorts) is a luxury I can ill afford at the moment. (He turns to leave, then stops) I trust your diagnostic teams are up to the task. We can't afford... mistakes.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text:
Severus, rest is often a vital component in the effectiveness of certain magical diagnostics, but we will work within your current parameters.

As for our diagnostic teams: you have my absolute assurance that they are among the most skilled and discreet practitioners in their respective fields, hand-picked for their expertise in dark curses and complex magical signatures. They are keenly aware of the gravity of your situation and the unique nature of this Mark. We understand that 'mistakes' are not an option, and every precaution will be taken. They are fully briefed on the need for both speed and meticulous accuracy.

We take this as seriously as you do. We will be expecting you tomorrow at 6:30 AM.

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: I'll be there. (He looks back once more) Ensure that every moment counts. (Then he leaves, the door closing behind him with a quiet click)
